description: Returns the nights of one UK month with a dark-sky window, when the Sun is more than 18° below the horizon and the Moon is down, at one of 24 UK places, with each night's window times, hours and Moon phase. For photography it returns each night's Moon window, when the Moon is at least 5° up while the Sun is more than 6° below the horizon. Times are UK time, GMT or BST.

month.description: UK calendar month as YYYY-MM, from 1900-01 to 2100-12. The current UK month without it.

place.description: One of 24 UK places, such as London, Edinburgh, Cardiff, Belfast, Leeds or Lerwick. London without it.

purpose.description: Dark lists nights with a moonless dark-sky window; photo lists nights with a Moon photography window. Dark without it.

name: plan_dark_skies
title: Dark-sky and Moon photography nights
